name: Miyasaka Kaori
source:
Kaori seems to be a very sexy and glamorous girl. She comes by the Sakuragi cake shop on a regular basis to feed her sweet tooth, but she also tries to tempt [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url] to come visit her establishment. She works as a hostess in a bunny bar called "Carrot". This bunny bar is also located in the shopping mall where Sakuragi's cake shop is. The hostesses must wear certain uniforms - bunny costumes! Kaori has always been a very quiet and introverted girl, but recently, she's started to like the idea of being looked at.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.jastusa.com/target-pheromone.html]JAST USA[/url]]
